title: MoldFirstBloom
proposition: Keep interactive presentation separate from authoritative game state.
story: MoldFirstBloom is a mobile-oriented Blazor WebAssembly vertical slice combining an isolated deterministic C# engine with a responsive browser interface. Players preview, rotate and confirm spatial moves while successful actions support reproducible replay, historical inspection and IndexedDB restoration.
contribution: I implemented the browser-independent engine, integrated Verdant Replay and History, created the touch-first Blazor interface and engineered replay-based IndexedDB restoration with compatibility checks.

reflection.summary: A user-facing application can remain fluid and expressive while its authoritative state, action history and reconstruction rules stay explicit and independently testable.

limitations: This is a Phase 1 vertical slice rather than a complete or released game.
Several broader mechanics and interface areas remain deferred or represented only by scaffolding.
End-to-end browser, persistence, Razor component and JavaScript tests are not established.

provenance.description: Mechanically derived from the controlling public projection.
